title: Dialogue
body:
-I love you soooo much
-I love you soooo much
-Have a great time
-Have a great time
-Thank youuu
-Have a good day at work
-Thank you sooo much
-Very good work
-Thank youuu
-You're welcomeee, I love you so so much
-Me toooo

What if there are problems,
what if we live under pressure.
Love always lifts our spirits.
and this funny morning dialogue between the neighbors, a dad and his young daughter, made my day.

"When life leaves us blind
love keeps us kind"
The Messenger, Linkin Park

y.f.
